decks.notes: This deck focuses on using instant reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance to bring back powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier from the graveyard for explosive plays. It also utilizes cards like Solitude and Force of Negation to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck includes control elements like Thoughtseize and Teferi, Time Raveler to maintain board presence and ensure the combo goes off smoothly. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing blink effects to continuously return powerful creatures to the battlefield, disrupting the opponent's plans while maintaining a steady stream of threats. By combining aggressive creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Solitude with blink cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck can apply pressure while also controlling the board. With a mix of removal spells and utility creatures like Witch Enchanter and Quantum Riddler, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures and using them to control the game. Cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate enable you to bring back creatures like Griselbrand or Atraxa, Grand Unifier for a quick advantage. Thoughtseize helps disrupt your opponent's strategy while Quantum Riddler and Fallaji Archaeologist provide additional utility. The deck also includes a few counterspells like Force of Negation to protect your combo pieces. Overall, the strategy revolves around exploiting the graveyard and surprise plays to outmaneuver your opponent.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively deploy threats on the board while maintaining card advantage and flexibility through card draw and manipulation. By utilizing efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, along with powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart, the deck aims to pressure the opponent early and finish the game quickly. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration allows for card selection and card advantage to outpace the opponent in the mid to late game.

This Boros aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ocelot Pride, supported by powerful spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm. Blood Moon disrupts opponent's mana base while Arena of Glory boosts your creatures. Ranger-Captain of Eos and Seasoned Pyromancer provide card advantage and board presence. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah is a versatile planeswalker that can buff your team or clear the board. Overall, the deck focuses on fast-paced aggression and resource denial to secure victory.

This deck focuses on rapidly generating tokens with the combination of Blade of the Bloodchief and Sowing Mycospawn to create a powerful army. It also utilizes Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Kozilek's Command for powerful win conditions. The deck includes support cards like Urza's Saga and Ancient Stirrings to search for key pieces. Additionally, it has some disruption elements with cards like Malevolent Rumble and Soul-Guide Lantern. Overall, the key strategy is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with a massive army of tokens and powerful creatures.

The deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures with different abilities to create powerful combos and synergies. By utilizing cards like Devoted Druid, Vizier of Remedies, and Walking Ballista, the deck can generate infinite mana and deal lethal damage in a single turn. The toolbox nature of the creatures allows for flexibility in adapting to different game states, while Leyline of Abundance and Green Sun's Zenith provide additional support and consistency. The deck aims to quickly build a formidable board presence and overwhelm the opponent with its explosive combos.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly deploy low-cost aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while utilizing spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to control the board and push through damage. The deck also includes cards like Mutagenic Growth and Violent Urge to give additional boosts to its creatures, allowing for fast and explosive plays. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help with card selection and card advantage, ensuring the deck can maintain its aggressive tempo throughout the game.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ocelot Pride to pressure the opponent and get in early damage. It also utilizes powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge to control the board and finish off the opponent. The deck includes a mix of creatures, spells, and lands to create a fast-paced and resilient strategy that can overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize.

This deck is focused on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption, removal spells, and counterspells. It aims to control the board and out-value the opponent by utilizing a variety of efficient threats and card advantage engines. The deck includes a mix of powerful control elements like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, along with versatile creatures like Quantum Riddler and Abhorrent Oculus to pressure the opponent. The goal is to maintain control of the game while slowly grinding out a victory through incremental advantages.

The deck revolves around combining Allosaurus Rider with Eldritch Evolution or Neoform to cheat out huge creatures like Griselbrand or Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant early in the game. It also utilizes cards like Pact of Negation and Veil of Summer to protect the combo from disruption. The deck aims to win quickly using powerful creatures and overwhelming the opponent before they have a chance to respond. The inclusion of cards like Endurance and Atraxa, Grand Unifier provide additional support and versatility to the strategy.

The deck focuses on using mana acceleration from cards like Disciple of Freyalise and Eldrazi Temple to quickly ramp into powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. Control elements come from cards like Malevolent Rumble and Ugin's Labyrinth to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also utilizes Fight Rigging to control the board and protect its own creatures. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures and powerful control elements while steadily gaining advantage through mana ramp.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with key creatures and then using powerful reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance to bring them back onto the battlefield for a game-ending combo. The deck includes cards like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Griselbrand to take advantage of this strategy, while also including disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation to protect the combo. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful, reanimated threats.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board and hand through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a strong board presence with efficient threats. The deck utilizes Leylines to protect key permanents and Leyline of the Guildpact to boost the power of multicolored creatures. The deck also features card advantage engines like Shardless Agent and Quantum Riddler to ensure a steady stream of resources. Overall, the deck excels at controlling the game and outvaluing the opponent.

This deck focuses on assembling the Allosaurus Combo, utilizing cards like Neoform, Eldritch Evolution, and Allosaurus Rider to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant. The deck includes support cards like Consign to Memory and Summoner's Pact to help search for key pieces of the combo. The inclusion of cards like Ureni, the Song Unending and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional protection and resilience to disrupt opponents' strategies. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm opponents with high-powered creatures.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with cards like Burning Inquiry and Faithless Looting to enable the mechanic of discarding cards to play additional creatures like Hollow One and Vengevine. This allows the deck to put a lot of pressure on the opponent early in the game and potentially overwhelm them with a swarm of aggressive creatures. The deck also contains removal spells like Lightning Bolt to deal with opposing threats and maintain board control. The overall strategy is to be fast and relentless in attacking the opponent.
